additional_info.subject: ID0368865-DC/Si-D/IE[170003301] - EcoG ERR69 patch request CRM:00315001593
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Jason,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S2 170003301
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
E7gWMK
Problem Description
: ERR 69 patch request
Troubleshooting
:
Yesterday I performed the patch update for every outlet.
All the outlets except the Disp2 outlet, worked completely fine
For Disp2 the FW wasn't applied successfully and as such it made the EcoG faulty.
With the assistance from R&D, we tried some remote commands to try and bring the EcoG back to operation.
Unsuccessfully.
After the engineer went on-site with a spare EcoG module, we still tested some scenarios to see if the EcoG module was really faulty.
Unsuccessfully, we had to replace the EcoG module to have the outlet working again.
Again, I'm really sorry for the inconvience caused.
Defective part name/MLFB: EcoG LE dispenser
Component serial number:
Please provide me this
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred):
Error polling coap://10.20.17.103:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'SECC_DC4_MB_Problem_KF212' initial value true - (loss of communication DC4 and SECC)
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'DC4_CableTempSensor_XD240' initial value true - (VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1)
Consequence of not having SECC DC4 communication
Active error flags before replacement:
SECC_DC4_MB_Problem_KF212
Device-specific error code
(if applicable): Error while fetching APIs
Outcome of wiring checkup: Not an issue since the charger was completely fine, it only stopped working after a failed update
Commissioning checklist:
Please provide me this
Commissioning date:
Please provide me this
Field service report:
Please provide me this
Date of failure: 15/July/2024 ~10am GMT
Device pingable y/n: No (10.20.17.103)
SECC dump view logs
(see "EcoG Troubleshooting notes" on the side of this page): Not possible as we have information corrupted
SECC state logs
(see "EcoG Troubleshooting notes" on the side of this page): Same as above
For future reference, your ticket number is
0368865
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
